cd /app/tmp/t && cat > mkrep.py <<'EOF'
import json, sys
P,R,D = 8,128,32
slotsn, window = 16, 8
buf=[None]*slotsn
sent=[0]*P; acked=[0]*P; upnext=[0]*P; floor=0
received=[[] for _ in range(P)]
inp=[[[r+q for i in range(D)] for q in range(R)] for r in range(P)]
pend={}; created=0
events=[]
class E:
    __slots__=("seq","ranks","sum")
    def __init__(self,q): self.seq=q; self.ranks=set(); self.sum=[0]*D
def mk(kind,rank,seq,value):
    global created
    if len(pend)>=2000 or created>=190000:
        return None
    pend[created]=[kind,rank,seq,value]; created+=1
    return created-1
def ev(kind, *a):
    events.append([kind]+list(a))
# generate: repeatedly send a batch of messages from every rank then fully drain
it=0
while len(events) < 19800 and created < 185000:
    q=it
    if q>=R: break
    if all(sent[r]<=q<min(R,sent[r]+window) for r in range(P)):
        ids=[]
        ok=True
        for r in range(P):
            pid=mk("up",r,q,inp[r][q])
            if pid is None: ok=False; break
            ids.append(pid)
            ev("send", r, q)
        if not ok: break
        # drain: deliver each up, each uack, each down, each dack
        li=len(ids)
        for k in range(li):
            ev("deliver", ids[k])
            # deliver the uack created:
            uid=created-1
            ev("deliver", uid)
        # after all ups delivered, the last one created downs for all ranks
        downs=list(pend.keys())
        for i in sorted(downs):
            k2=pend[i][0]
            if k2=="down":
                ev("deliver", i)
        dacks=[i for i in sorted(pend.keys()) if pend[i][0]=="dack"]
        for i in dacks:
            ev("deliver", i)
        it+=1
    else:
        break
req={"op":"replay","inputs":inp,"slots":slotsn,"window":window,"events":events[:20000]}
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(req)+"\n")
sys.stderr.write("events=%d created=%d\n"%(len(events),created))
EOF
python3 mkrep.py > big6.jsonl && wc -c big6.jsonl && time (python3 /app/submission/main.py < big6.jsonl | head -c 60)
